sources.title: GitHub - Irshad-11/Onubad.ai: A General-Purpose English to Bangla PDF ...
sources.snippet: Onubad.ai is a research-focused project dedicated to fine-tuning Meta's NLLB (No Language Left Behind) model for English to Bangla translation. Our goal is to move away from stiff, robotic translations and achieve a natural, colloquial, and context-aware flow that resonates with native Bangla speakers.
